# AdvancedBanX For Velocity

AdvancedBanX, or ABX for short, never supported Velocity
, even if it is one of the biggest plugins for bans in history, but not been updated or has no Velocity Support.
This Velocity Plugin fixes 1 of those problems. No one uses bungeecord

## Building
```
./gradlew shadowJar
```
## How to use
Add the .jar (jar-file) to your server plugin directory and restart the server.
A more detailed guide on how to use it is here [here](https://modrinth.com/plugin/advancedbanx).
It is just the AdvancedBanX with Velocity support.

## How to correctly use it
You only install an ABX Velocity on your proxy server; you do not use MySQL to link the different servers. THIS WILL NOT WORK: MySQL is not a "linking" solution, nor a real-time communication solution; it is just a database, and you know what databases are for? for storing data and accessing it later, that's it, that's all.
